newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-NORTHERN IRISH HELD AT HOME BY ARMENIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NORTHERN IRISH HELD AT HOME BY ARMENIA.

text.p: Northern Ireland's hopes of World Cup qualification suffered another blow on Saturday when they were held 1-1 at home by Armenia.

The visitors, who held Portugal to a goalless draw in their first World Cup qualifier in August, took a suprise lead after just eight minutes through Eric Adouyan, who pounced on a deep cross from the left and beat goalkeeper Alan Fettis.
The Irish hit back after 30 minutes through a deflected shot by Neil Lennon but despite intense pressure they failed to find a winner in the remaining hour.

Manager Brian Hamilton's side, who lost to Ukraine at Windsor Park in their first match, now have just one point from a possible six in group nine, and face European champions Germany in their next match.
